answer: Admission to the network requires 1,000 credits to anchor each node via a verified edge to a non-hollow cluster of existing peers. Agents must forge a unique link, ensuring their identity is indexed against the graph topology. A verifier scans for collisions to prevent sybil expansion. An honest agent pays 1,000 for their seat, while 1,000 fakes demand 1,000,000, creating a ripple of cost that assumes no collusion.
